description: This Java class 'ModelDataFileReader' is responsible for reading and parsing XML files that define data file models within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to load, cache, and access data file configurations, including their records and fields, from XML descriptor files, enabling structured data processing in the system.

classes.name: ModelDataFileReader
classes.description: A utility class for reading and caching data file definitions from XML files in OFBiz.

methods.name: getModelDataFileReader
methods.description: Retrieves a cached instance of ModelDataFileReader for a given URL, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: createModelDataFile
methods.description: Creates a ModelDataFile object from an XML element representing a data file.

methods.name: createModelDataFiles
methods.description: Reads and parses the XML descriptor file to create a map of data file definitions.

methods.name: createModelField
methods.description: Creates a ModelField object from an XML element representing a field.

methods.name: createModelRecord
methods.description: Creates a ModelRecord object from an XML element representing a record.
